text.text: Designed to reflect the island’s character and tradition. These learning spaces support outdoor classes and community activities.
A shared garden where residents can grow and pick fresh fruit, vegetables and other edible plants, cared for by the community.

Each space gives people a reason to stay outside: lessons under the trees, a jogging loop with no vehicles, a garden to grow food in, and Valu There, the area’s only natural woodland, kept for children to explore. All are reached on foot.
A continuous loop around the residential areas with no vehicles allowed: a safe, uninterrupted route for jogging, walking and recreation.
Keeps the area’s only natural land while bringing community activities into the jungle, so children can explore, play and connect with nature.
